stories.title: Follow live: Brewers strike immediately as Jackson Chourio connects for first-pitch home run
Rams' Jackson has suspension cut to 1 game following appeal
stories.summary: Alaric Jackson's suspension for punching Bradley Chubb after Monday night's game between the Bills and Rams was reduced from two games to one.

stories.title: Slumping Ohtani dropped to sixth in lineup, 'all on board' for Game 3
stories.summary: Dodgers star Shohei Ohtani, who is hitting just .150 this postseason, will bat sixth in the lineup for Wednesday night's NLCS Game 3 against the Brewers.

stories.title: Sources: FIFA set to change rules that led to Balogun World Cup red card reversal
stories.summary: FIFA is set to amend its rules to prevent a repeat of the controversial reversal of the World Cup suspension issued to Folarin Balogun, sources have told ESPN.

stories.title: Warriors' Porzingis out indefinitely but will remain around team
stories.summary: Warriors center Kristaps Porzingis will remain out indefinitely with a private health-related issue but will be around the team.
